sloka: ऊचुर्लक्षणिनो ये मां पुत्रिण्यविधवेति च ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.२ ।।।।
transliteration: ūcurlakṣaṇino ye māṁ putriṇyavidhaveti ca ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "Whoever was capable of predicting the future have said that I will be the mother of sons and not become a widow. Now if Rama is dead, they become liars."
